artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 1 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for the English edition of Volume 1, featuring Adachi and Shimamura sitting together on a bench. Illustrated by Non. This edition was released by Seven Seas Entertainment in 2020.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 2 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 2's cover shows Adachi and Shimamura in a more intimate moment, reflecting the deepening of their relationship as the series progresses. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 3 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: This cover introduces the supporting cast—Hino and Nagafuji—alongside our main duo, signaling the expanding world of the series. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 4 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 4's cover captures a quiet, contemplative moment between Adachi and Shimamura, reflecting the introspective nature of this volume. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 5 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The soft color palette of this cover emphasizes the gentle, melancholic tone that characterizes Volume 5. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 6 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: This cover features a warmer, more vibrant palette, reflecting the emotional growth of the characters as the series reaches its midpoint. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 7 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 7's cover shows a more playful side of the characters, with a bright and cheerful composition that matches the tone of this volume. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 8 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The cover of Volume 8 features a particularly striking composition, with the characters framed against a dramatic sky. Illustrated by Non.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 9 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 9's cover marks a significant milestone in the series, with the characters appearing more mature and confident. Illustrated by Shizue Kaneko, who took over as illustrator from this volume onward.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 10 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The cover of Volume 10 features a beautiful, soft color palette that reflects the emotional depth of this installment. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 11 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 11's cover is particularly atmospheric, using soft lighting to create an intimate mood. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 12 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 12's cover features the characters in a moment of quiet connection, reflecting the emotional maturity they've developed over the course of the series. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 13 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for Volume 13, the latest installment in the English edition. The artwork beautifully captures the growth and intimacy of the characters' relationship, with a warm and hopeful atmosphere. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume 99.9 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume 99.9 features a celebratory illustration, highlighting the enduring bond between Adachi and Shimamura. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume SS Cover
artworks.curatorNote: The cover for Volume SS captures the characters in a charming, relaxed setting, offering a unique side-story aesthetic. Illustrated by Raemz.

artworks.title: Light Novel Volume SS2 Cover
artworks.curatorNote: Volume SS2 presents a beautiful, nostalgic illustration that continues the side-story tradition of the series with elegance. Illustrated by Raemz.

Non.bio: Non is the original illustrator of the Adachi to Shimamura light novel series from Volumes 1 through 8. Known for their delicate and expressive character art, Non's illustrations have become synonymous with the series' gentle and introspective tone.

Shizue Kaneko.bio: Shizue Kaneko took over as the illustrator for Volume 9 of the Adachi to Shimamura light novel series. Their art style brought a fresh perspective to the characters while maintaining the series' signature warmth.

Raemz.bio: Raemz became the illustrator for the Adachi to Shimamura light novel series starting from Volume 10. Their artwork continues to capture the intimate and emotional core of the series with a distinctive, luminous style.

ENGLISH LN Cover.description: Cover illustrations for the English edition of the Adachi to Shimamura light novel series, published by Seven Seas Entertainment.
